players.product: Precision machined chambers, weldments, gas distribution plates (showerheads), metal heaters, electrostatic chucks, coatings, gas lines and gas delivery systems for etch, deposition and implant equipment

quarterly_data.quarter: Fortune Precision results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Zheng Guangwen (H1 2026 results briefing): H1 2026 net profit attributable rose 992.90% to RMB 13,416.87 ten-thousand and net profit excluding non-recurring items was RMB 8,989.93 ten-thousand, a return to profit, driven by fast revenue growth whose scale effect is repairing gross margin and by lower expense ratios from better internal management; he expects marginal cost to keep falling and profitability to keep improving as capacity at the Nantong, Beijing and Singapore bases is gradually released. CFO Luan Yufeng said H1 financial expenses rose 155.84% to RMB 5,257.51 ten-thousand because of larger FX losses, as sales and purchases are partly priced in foreign currencies.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 recurring net profit RMB 8,989.93 ten-thousand; net profit RMB 13,416.87 ten-thousand (+992.90%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Fortune Precision results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D and acquisition (H1 2026 results briefing): board secretary Lang Yu said H1 2026 R&D investment was RMB 15,524.58 ten-thousand, up 28.09%, 6.70% of revenue, focused on advanced-process areas - gas distribution plates (showerheads), electrostatic chucks, metal heaters, special surface treatments, gas delivery system integration and smart process development - with 439 patents and software copyrights at period end, 104 of them invention patents. Chairman Zheng Guangwen said that after the acquisition of a 65% stake in Riyang Electronic Technology (Shanghai), the two sides will create synergies in business, technology, markets and products.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D RMB 15,524.58 ten-thousand (+28.09%, 6.70% of revenue); 65% stake in Riyang Electronic Technology (Shanghai)
